Title: deno.json + version.ts
Description: Create desktop-app/deno.json with imports (zod npm:^3.25, std/path jsr:^1, drizzle-orm npm:^0.44 over runtime built-in node:sqlite for the local SQLite file), the desktop block (name 'Command Centre', identifier com.commandcentre.app, icons ../design/app.ico, backend cef, output ../dist/CommandCentre) and the full task set (dev/build/clean/make-icon/build:grammar/build:learn/build:inputs/build:dir/build:msi/build:installer/test/release plus db:migrate running db/migrations/ against the app-data SQLite file). Create version.ts with APP_NAME + APP_VERSION.
Acceptance Criteria: deno task dev starts without config errors; desktop block accepted by deno desktop; every task in plan §11 present plus db:migrate; drizzle-orm resolves (node:sqlite is runtime built-in
Notes: no native module — N-API breaks deno desktop); db:migrate on a fresh dir creates command-center.db with every table; build:dir/build:msi chain build:grammar+build:learn+build:inputs as prerequisites.
column11: Pin Deno 2.9.6. backend MUST be cef, never webview (blank window on Win11). --allow-net needed for hub/publish; --allow-run needed in test for shell spawning. Drizzle everywhere per stack.md: the desktop persists via drizzle over a local SQLite file (C1), website/API via drizzle-orm/d1 (H1/I1).

Title: main.ts static server + window
Description: Implement main.ts: resolveWeb() probing cwd-relative then import.meta-relative static dirs; MIME map; serveStatic() with single URL-decode, rejection of any backslash and any '..' segment, extension whitelist; multi-page routing (index for /, the other five pages for /<name>.html and /<name>); setupWindow() adopting Deno.BrowserWindow with restored geometry and 300ms debounced persistence; registerBindings(win).
Acceptance Criteria: Window opens; / serves index.html; each of the six pages serves with correct Content-Type; traversal paths (.., backslash, encoded variants) rejected 400/403; geometry restored across relaunch.
Notes: Port resolveWeb/serveStatic/setupWindow from C:/projects/compressy/desktop-app/main.ts. Never hardcode a port — Deno.serve uses DENO_SERVE_ADDRESS.

Title: static/index.html from design
Description: Create static/index.html from design/index.html: keep the full markup and UI semantics (command cards, variable panel, terminal block, tags, status), strip the demo <script> and DEFAULTS array, add the vendor/grammar/templates/app/alpine script tags in documented order, add the x-data component root.
Acceptance Criteria: Page renders every design section; Alpine component mounts; no demo JS; no console errors on load.
Notes: Demo script is preview-only; its UI semantics (selection, filters, footers, disabled states) are preserved, its fake data is not.

Title: static/styles.css from six designs
Description: Build static/styles.css: one :root token block copied verbatim from design/index.html:39-47, then per-page blocks ported from each design's inline <style>; keep the od-* layout primitives in an @layer od-layout exactly as declared; keep the 640px media queries and the prefers-reduced-motion guard.
Files: desktop-app/static/styles.css; design/index.html; design/command.html; design/add.html; design/learn.html; design/hub.html; design/publish.html
Acceptance Criteria: Token values identical to design/index.html :root; all six pages render with correct layout; od-* primitives resolve; responsive and reduced-motion rules intact.
Notes: Five of six pages depend on the od-* primitives, so they must not be dropped in the trim.

Title: Vendor Alpine, Mustache, icons
Description: Download pinned Alpine 3.x and Mustache 4.2.0 into static/vendor/ (no CDN at runtime). Copy design/icons/{powershell,bash,ubuntu}.svg into static/icons/ so the shell picker can serve them from the embedded root.
Acceptance Criteria: Vendor files present at pinned versions and served with 200; all three shell icons resolve from /icons/ in the window.
Notes: The app can only serve from its embedded root, so design/icons/ must be copied into static/icons/.

Title: Vendor the input layer
Description: Build enhanced-inputs (node enhanced-inputs/build.mjs), copy dist/index.js and dist/themes/default.css into static/vendor/, author the token-remap layer mapping --input-*/--primary onto the design's :root tokens, and vendor range-slider-element. Wire all of it into the build:inputs precondition of build:dir/build:msi via scripts/vendor-inputs.ts.
Acceptance Criteria: An <e-input type="text"> upgrades and is styled in a real window; <range-slider> is registered (type=range renders a live slider); a clean clone + deno task build:dir produces all static/vendor inputs without manual steps.
Notes: range-slider-element is declared by the library but NEVER imported in src/ — without vendoring it all 9 range tokens render inert. dist/ is gitignored, so this must be a build step, not a one-off copy.

Title: make-icon.ts + design/app.ico
Description: Author scripts/make-icon.ts emitting a PNG-in-ICO from a new design/icon.png, and generate design/app.ico. Required because --icon points at a file that does not exist today.
Acceptance Criteria: design/app.ico exists and is a valid ICO; deno task build:dir succeeds (no missing-icon error); the icon shows on the built exe and installed shortcut.
Notes: CERTAIN blocker for build:dir and build:msi until this exists.

Title: static/command.html from design
Description: Create static/command.html from design/command.html: keep the raw template view, rendered preview with labelled chips, dl fields, metadata table with per-option tables and the export/publish affordances; strip the demo <script> and seed data; add the shared script tags in documented order and the x-data detail root.
Acceptance Criteria: Page renders every design section with no demo JS; the detail component mounts for a known ?id= (behaviour in E3).
Notes: Fix the design defect in the port: #missing is never unhidden — an unknown ?id= must render a real not-found state, never the showcase fallback.

Title: static/add.html from design
Description: Create static/add.html from design/add.html: keep the form fields (name, cmd, desc, cwd, preview, ask mode) plus a tag field (the design has none, but every command needs one); keep the CodeMirror mount with the textarea fallback; strip the demo <script>; add the shared script tags and the x-data author root.
Acceptance Criteria: Form, editor mount, preview pane and variable metadata editors render; no demo JS; the CodeMirror module slot is present (wired in E4).
Notes: Vendor the six CM6 packages locally — the design's esm.sh importmap breaks offline.

Title: static/learn.html from design
Description: Create static/learn.html from design/learn.html: keep the text+widget filters and the reference table skeleton; strip the 30 hand-maintained rows (regenerated from registry.ts live table by build:learn in E5); add the shared script tags and the x-data learn root.
Acceptance Criteria: Filters render; the tbody is populated by build output only, never hand-edited.
Notes: The design ships 30 hand-maintained rows — generation removes the drift risk.

Title: static/hub.html from design
Description: Create static/hub.html from design/hub.html: keep the search palette, package rail, sort, paging, recents, install/add buttons and keyboard hints; strip the HUB demo array and the cliState install simulation; add the shared script tags and the x-data hub root.
Acceptance Criteria: All hub sections render with no demo data; the component mounts and fills from hubList() (behaviour in F3).
Notes: The 25%-per-tick install simulation is not ported — hubInstall() probes for real (F1).

Title: static/publish.html from design
Description: Create static/publish.html from design/publish.html: keep the command select, metadata-file loader, reviewer fields and the inline success panel with its three links; strip the demo <script>; add the shared script tags and the x-data publish root.
Acceptance Criteria: Form and success panel render; submit path is wired in F4; success shows the panel without redirecting (matches the design).
Notes: Keep the design's field renames: command→cmd, description→desc, workingDirectory→cwd.

Title: Phase A smoke gate
Description: Smoke test the scaffold: deno task dev, window opens, all six pages render, static assets and vendored inputs load, no console errors.
Acceptance Criteria: Window opens via deno desktop --hmr; DevTools shows no errors; all six pages plus styles/app.js/vendor scripts return 200; an <e-input> upgrades and is themed.
Notes: Phase gate. If the window is blank, confirm backend is cef before debugging elsewhere.

Title: registry.ts — 30 live + 108 retired + 7 aliases
Description: Transcribe the type registry into registry.ts as the single source of truth: TypeRow = [name, widget, label, defaultParams?] with the 30-row CC_INPUT_TYPES from design/add.html (identical in index/command), plus the 108-row CC_RETIRED_TYPES as a read-tolerance table (same widget/label parsing, flagged retired:true, never offered in autocomplete), plus the 7 aliases from the ALIASES map and lookupType() checking live → retired → aliases.
Acceptance Criteria: Test asserts 30 live names with the widget histogram (select 7, text 5, file 3, number 2, date/color/password/radio/buttongroup/checkbox/switch/range/time/datetime/textarea/multiselect/keyvalue 1 each); 14 live rows carry built-in defaults; 108 retired names resolve with retired:true; all 7 aliases resolve to live targets; lookupType returns null for truly unknown names.
Notes: add.html's array form is authoritative (labels + defaults); identical arrays ship in index/command. hub.html defines no arrays — it references the shared lookup.

Title: grammar.ts — parse, render, example
Description: Implement grammar.ts: parseToken (the §1.2 regex + per-widget param parsing), parseVarInstances (occurrence keying with occ/iid/total), parseVars (deduped by key), renderCmd (occurrence key → base key → meta.example → leave raw), exampleFor (one merged implementation), rangeSpec (with the =default strip fix) and ccAutoGenerate (add.html's ladder verbatim).
Acceptance Criteria: The three grammar positions parse to distinct fields (dot-suffix sets auto, colon sets default/params); rangeSpec('18-28=23') === {min:18,max:28,step:1}; a repeated token yields iids 'input.dir' and 'input.dir#2' with total 2; unknown input.* names pass through verbatim.
Notes: Single biggest defect to fix: rangeSpec ignores declared bounds whenever params contain '=default', which is EVERY demo range token.

Title: build-grammar.ts → static/grammar.js
Description: Author scripts/build-grammar.ts emitting static/grammar.js from the TS source (types stripped, exports kept) so the webview shares the exact parser, and add a staleness test asserting the emitted file's hash matches the source.
Acceptance Criteria: build:grammar regenerates the file; the staleness test fails when grammar.ts changes without regenerating; the browser sees identical parse results to Deno.
Notes: Generated artifact + hash guard is the only way to avoid grammar drift between the two runtimes.

Title: grammar_test.ts
Description: Write tests/grammar_test.ts covering §1.2 exhaustively: each position alone and combined, every colon-default form per type, occurrence keying, alias resolution (all 7), retired-name read-tolerance (stored commands using retired names still parse, flagged retired), unknown-token passthrough, rangeSpec, exampleFor across all 30 live types, and the legacy ':autogenerate' read-tolerance.
Acceptance Criteria: All tests green; asserts the 30/108/7 registry shape; asserts a retired token (e.g. {{input.vcodec:h264}}) parses with retired:true; explicitly asserts {{input.text:autogenerate}} resolves to the literal default 'autogenerate' (the tolerance must not hijack a real default), and that legacy stored ':autogenerate' tokens still parse.
Notes: Phase gate — everything downstream depends on this parser being correct.

Title: types.ts + drizzle db (SQLite) + settings.ts
Description: Implement types.ts (CommandIdSchema CVCV-CVCV-CVCV, lean CommandRow: id/command/title/description/source_folder/tags[]/created_at/updated_at, MetadataDoc sidecar schema with variables/values/shell/askMode, AppSettings, bindings + run contracts, all zod schemas); ids.ts (18-consonant CVCV generator + validator); db/schema.ts (drizzle sqlite-core tables: lean commands + settings/hub_cache/hub_state/publish_queue/publish_status which stay in DB); db/db.ts (node:sqlite + drizzle sqlite-proxy over <app-data>/command-center/command-center.db with migrate-on-open from db/migrations/); metadata.ts (atomic {id}.metadata.json sidecars under <app-data>/command-center/commands/); and settings.ts (DEFAULT_SETTINGS + load/save + window geometry via the settings table). DB holds only command/title/description/source_folder/tags (+timestamps); all other metadata lives in sidecars.
Files: desktop-app/types.ts; desktop-app/ids.ts; desktop-app/metadata.ts; desktop-app/db/schema.ts; desktop-app/db/db.ts; desktop-app/db/migrations/**; desktop-app/settings.ts; desktop-app/tests/ids_test.ts; desktop-app/tests/settings_test.ts
Acceptance Criteria: ids_test.ts + settings_test.ts pass against an ephemeral SQLite file + temp sidecar dir: CVCV format/10k uniqueness/validator rejects legacy+uppercase; lean commands table has exactly id/command/title/description/source_folder/tags/created_at/updated_at; settings defaults on fresh DB, roundtrip, partial merge; AppSettingsSchema rejects out-of-range; migrate-on-open creates every table; corrupt sidecar falls back without throwing.
Notes: Drizzle for index tables (lean commands + settings/hub/publish stay in SQLite); sidecar JSON for all command metadata. App-data root: LOCALAPPDATA then USERPROFILE then HOME then '.', under command-center/. CVCV consonants: bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwz (18) + vowels aeiou.

Title: seeds.ts — merged seed set
Description: Author seeds.ts exporting DEFAULT_COMMANDS: the 16 distinct design templates collapsed to 12 seeds by merging the four same-command pairs (ffmpeg, docker-run, git-log, npm-run, richer index.html variant kept), each with a fixed checked-in CVCV id (deterministic) plus sidecar seed metadata, and port SHOWCASE's curated vars metadata (18 entries, 39 labels) onto the ffmpeg seed's sidecar.
Acceptance Criteria: 12 seeds with unique valid CVCV ids; no id collision with user or hub-added commands (fresh CVCV per duplicate/add); ffmpeg seed sidecar carries per-option labels; the app never needs a 'showcase' fallback.
Notes: The two design files ship non-intersecting id spaces (n1..n7 vs c1..c9 + showcase), which is why every built-in card link lands on the fallback today.

Title: library.ts — CRUD, search, import/export
Description: Implement library.ts over drizzle + metadata.ts: list/get/save (upsert lean DB row zod-parsed + atomic sidecar write, sidecar first then DB)/remove (DB row + sidecar delete)/duplicate (fresh CVCV id + ' (copy)' + sidecar copy)/search (case-insensitive substring over command+title+description+source_folder only)/importJson (accepts a SavedCommand or a §1.4 metadata document, splits to row+sidecar, fresh CVCV on collision; non-CVCV ids rejected)/exportJson (joins row+sidecar to the §1.4 document, writes <id>.metadata.json). Seed from seeds.ts when the commands table is empty. Values/shell/askMode/vars live in sidecars keyed commandId → iid, never in the DB row.
Acceptance Criteria: library_test.ts green against an ephemeral SQLite file + temp sidecar dir: create → export → import → deep-equal; duplicate yields a fresh valid CVCV id; delete removes row + sidecar; search matches the design's substring semantics over the 4 DB fields; missing/corrupt sidecar degrades gracefully; an exported <id>.metadata.json is accepted by design/publish.html's loader.
Notes: The metadata document field names are a hard contract: command/description/workingDirectory, not cmd/desc/cwd.

Title: widgetToEInput mapping + format lookup
Description: Add widgetToEInput(token) to registry.ts: the fixed table mapping the 17 live widgets onto <e-input type> values (text/email/url/search/uuid→text+format, number/port→number, date/time/datetime→date, color→color, password→password, select/country/timezone/currency/language/locale/license→select, radio/buttongroup→radio, multiselect→checkbox-group, checkbox/switch→checkbox, range→range, textarea→textarea, keyvalue→paired text fields), plus the file→text+action-button='browse' rule for the 3 file tokens.
Acceptance Criteria: Every one of the 30 live tokens resolves to a real <e-input type> with no accidental default fallthrough; the text-family format mapping, the 7 select-family lists and the 3 file tokens are asserted explicitly; retired tokens resolve through the same table via their recorded widget.
Notes: The library's type attribute accepts ~16 values — the registry and the element type are different axes; the mapping table bridges them.

Title: renderToken(token, value) element builder
Description: Implement renderToken(): build the <e-input> element for a Token — set type via widgetToEInput, name from token.iid (occurrence-keyed), value, label/placeholder/description from author metadata, min/max/step from rangeSpec for range and number, and append the correct option children (e-select-option / e-combobox-option / e-radio-option / e-checkbox-option) carrying labels and descriptions.
Acceptance Criteria: A select/radio token yields one option child per entry with author labels attached; a repeated token produces two elements named 'input.dir' and 'input.dir#2'; a checkbox with =off default starts unchecked; no element is created without a type.
Notes: Options are child custom elements, never a JSON attribute — _collectOptions() reads slotted children and hides them. Deno has no DOM: render.ts returns a descriptor; app.js materializes real DOM in Phase E.

Title: bindings.ts — the full API surface
Description: Implement bindings.ts registering every handler in the §7.4 contract (app, library, values/shells via sidecars, filesystem, hub, publish, settings), zod-validating every argument, and wire it into main.ts. Values/shells hit {id}.metadata.json, not DB tables.
Acceptance Criteria: Every Phase C binding callable from the webview; invalid args reject with a zod error surfaced as {name,message,stack}; pickFile/pickFolder open the native dialog; file/folder widgets receive absolute paths.
Notes: Bindings are the API — no HTTP routes for data. Execution bindings (run/getRunProgress/cancelRun) are registered when runner.ts lands (D2), since they need the shell registry.

Title: shell.ts — registry + probe
Description: Implement shell.ts: the SHELLS registry (powershell / bash / ubuntu with label, icon, binary and argv builder), binary resolution, and an installed-shell probe whose result feeds getPlatform().shells.
Acceptance Criteria: PowerShell is detected on this machine; bash/ubuntu report absent when WSL is missing; the UI never offers a shell that is not present.
Notes: Pass the resolved line to the shell's own -Command/-lc flag so it parses exactly once. Never build an argv array from a split string.

Title: runner.ts — real execution
Description: desktop-app/runner.ts; desktop-app/bindings.ts
Acceptance Criteria: Running a real command per shell yields correct stdout, stderr, exit code and cwd; cancelling ping -t leaves no surviving process; a line with an unresolved {{token}} is refused with a visible message; run/getRunProgress/cancelRun are registered on the window and callable from the webview.
Notes: Deno.Command has no windowsHide in 2.9.x — use node:child_process. Registers the execution bindings that Phase C deliberately left out. Not a PTY, so interactive prompts block; surface stderr and hint at it.

Title: runner_test.ts
Description: Write tests/runner_test.ts exercising echo, pwd/cwd correctness, a non-zero exit code, stderr capture, and the cancellation path against real powershell.exe and, when present, bash.exe.
Acceptance Criteria: All tests green; cancellation asserts the process tree is gone; tests skip cleanly rather than fail when bash is unavailable.
Notes: Requires --allow-run in the test task or these fail NotCapable. Phase gate.

Title: templates.js — list templates
Description: Author templates.js: the command card (shell button, name/desc, resolved cmdline, tags, run/status controls), the terminal block, detail rows, hub card, and publish record — compiled once at load, values precomputed by app.js.
Acceptance Criteria: Each template renders from its documented context shape; names and command text are escaped; no helper logic beyond precomputed fields.
Notes: Mirrors Compressy's templates.js pattern (XSS-safety through explicit precomputation).

Title: app.js — commands component
Description: Implement the Alpine commands component: list render, search (name+cmd+desc+cwd only, matching the design), tag filter, sort, list/grid toggle, shell cycle with per-command persistence, variable panel build/collect/validate, run with streaming output, cancel, and terminal copy/clear/hide.
Acceptance Criteria: End-to-end in the window: browse → open variables → fill → run; output streams into the terminal; the shell picker cycles only installed shells; validation blocks run with the design's exact message; cancel works mid-run.
Notes: The design's 260ms setTimeout transcript replay is not ported — output is real.

Title: app.js — detail component
Description: Implement the detail component: badges (tag, origin, published), raw template view, rendered preview with labelled chips, the dl fields (cwd, ask mode, id, source, published), the metadata table with per-option tables, and metadata .json export.
Acceptance Criteria: Unknown ?id= shows a real 'command not found' state (the design's #missing is unreachable); export writes command-<id>.metadata.json; the metadata table lists every input with its label and options.
Notes: The design never unhides #missing — unimplemented ids silently render the showcase. Fix that here.

Title: app.js — author component
Description: Implement the author component: CodeMirror 6 mount with the textarea fallback, live preview, variable metadata editors (label/description/per-option), the ↻ Regenerate control, save/edit/duplicate, plus the cwd and file pickers wired to bindings.pickFile/pickFolder for file-widget action-button='browse'.
Acceptance Criteria: CodeMirror loads from vendor (no CDN) and falls back to the textarea on failure; token highlighting distinguishes known from unknown tokens; type and option completion work; save→reopen restores author metadata; a file token fills an absolute path.
Notes: Vendor the six CM6 packages locally — the design's esm.sh importmap would break offline.

Title: app.js — learn component
Description: Implement the learn component: generate the 30 reference rows from registry.ts live table at build time (or render client-side) so the page cannot drift, keeping the text+widget filters; retired names are never listed.
Acceptance Criteria: Exactly the 30 live names appear, each once; the widget filter covers the live widgets; filters hide rows and their empty group headers correctly.
Notes: The design hand-maintains 30 rows — generation removes the drift risk.

Title: Status bar + version/platform
Description: Add the status bar showing real version, platform and installed shells via getVersion()/getPlatform(), replacing the design's placeholder strings.
Acceptance Criteria: Badge shows the real version and OS; the shell list reflects what was actually probed.

Title: Event wiring for the input layer
Description: Wire the input layer's events: delegate e:input/e:change/e:validate at the component root (they bubble and compose), attach hook:* listeners per element after insertion (they do not bubble or compose), and gate the Run button on e:validate.
Acceptance Criteria: Changing a field then blurring fires e:input + e:change + e:validate on the root; hook:onValidate fires only on the element; the Run button disables on an invalid field and re-enables when valid.
Notes: Exactly one validator owns each rule: the library handles presentation constraints, runner.ts remains the execution gate.

Title: inputs_test.ts + rendering verification
Description: Write tests/inputs_test.ts asserting renderToken produces the correct tag/type/attributes for every widget family, that option children carry author labels, that iid becomes name, and that repeated tokens yield distinct names. Then verify visually in a real window.
Acceptance Criteria: Tests green; in the window each widget family renders a themed, upgraded element with no unstyled/unknown tags; type=range is live (proving range-slider registered).
Notes: Phase gate. Covers the library having zero tests of its own.

Title: hub.ts — community data
Description: Implement hub.ts over drizzle: hubList with cache-first reads from the hub_cache table (15-minute TTL) and the §8.6 search semantics ported verbatim from hub.html (package: gate, weighted term ladder, longest-term highlight, server paging), hubPackages rail counts, hubInstall as a real where/--version probe, hubAdd copying a hub command into the local library with fromHub provenance, hubRecents via hub_state, and sort persistence.
Acceptance Criteria: Search replays hub.html's scoreRow vectors exactly; counts feed the rail; install state matches reality on machines with and without the CLI; adding the same hub id twice is a no-op; the Hub renders from the hub_cache table when the API is unreachable.
Notes: The design's install is a 25%-per-tick simulation — replace it with a real probe and drop '(simulated)'.

Title: publish.ts — export, outbox, submit
Description: Implement publish.ts over drizzle: publishExport emitting the §1.4 document, publishSubmit validating (command present, name ≥2, email regex) then inserting into the publish_queue table and POSTing to the API with retry, publishQueue reading the outbox table, and publish-status persistence in publish_status so the published badge is real.
Acceptance Criteria: A submission lands in the publish_queue table, appears via publishQueue(), POSTs successfully, and flips to pending-review; with the API down it stays queued and reports 'queued — will retry'; retries run on app start and hubRefresh.
Notes: The design writes cc-publish-queue and never reads it back; the published badge can never light up because setPub is never called.

Title: app.js — hub component
Description: Implement the hub component: search palette, package rail with counts, sort, paging, keyboard nav (/ to focus, Escape to clear, arrows to move, Enter to add), suggest chips, recents, and the install/add buttons with their status states.
Acceptance Criteria: Keyboard behaviour matches the design exactly; the rail and the package: token stay in sync; install and add update their labels and disabled states; recents cap at 5.

Title: app.js — publish component
Description: Implement the publish component: command select, metadata-file loader with the design's acceptance rule (kind === 'command-metadata' or a truthy command) and field rename mapping, validation with per-field errors, and the inline success panel with its three links.
Acceptance Criteria: A valid metadata file locks the select and fills the summary; an invalid file is rejected with the design's message; a successful submit shows the panel without redirecting.
Notes: Keep the design's field renames: command→cmd, description→desc, workingDirectory→cwd.

Title: API base + offline degradation
Description: Wire settings.hubApiBase into every hub/publish call (empty means the bundled endpoint; http://localhost:8787 during development) and implement the offline path: hub served from cache with a banner, publish queued and retried.
Acceptance Criteria: With the API unreachable the Hub still lists cached commands and search works; a publish attempt queues and reports accordingly; pointing hubApiBase at the real API makes both live.

Title: Error states and empty states
Description: Implement the error surfaces: the command-not-found page, per-command run failures with stderr visible, install failures, offline banners, and empty states for list/hub/search.
Acceptance Criteria: Every failure path shows an actionable message rather than a blank pane; a failed run keeps the terminal open with stderr and the exit code.
Notes: Verified 2026-09-21 non-hub scope (browser tests): not-found page, failed-run stderr plus exit with terminal open, empty list and search states. Install-failure, offline-banner and hub empty states need F1/F3 — stays Pending until then.

Title: Close guards
Description: Guard window close while a run is active (preventDefault + native Deno-side confirm) and while an authoring form has unsaved changes.
Acceptance Criteria: Closing mid-run prompts and keeps the app alive on cancel; closing a dirty author form prompts before discarding.
Notes: The design has no close guard at all.

Title: Full smoke pass + build
Description: Run the §15 verification table end to end, then deno task build producing dist/CommandCentre/ and dist/CommandCentre-msi/CommandCentre.msi, and confirm the compiled binary works standalone.
Acceptance Criteria: All §15 checks green; the compiled app launches and runs a command with the input layer rendering correctly; the MSI installs and launches.
Notes: Phase gate. Verify the input layer inside the compiled binary specifically — vendored assets must survive embedding. 2026-09-21: deno task build green (dir plus msi); standalone binary serves every page and asset from embedded VFS including e-input, range-slider and codemirror; Inno setup.exe path proven separately (G4). Blocked: hub and website section-15 rows (F5, H7) and the per-machine MSI install test.

Title: Installer (Inno Setup)
Description: Author scripts/installer.iss and scripts/build-installer.ps1 (extract payload, embed the icon, resolve the version from version.ts) and produce dist/CommandCentre-setup.exe.
Acceptance Criteria: deno task build:installer produces CommandCentre-setup.exe; installing and launching from the Start menu works.
Notes: Port scripts/build-installer.ps1 from Compressy (version.ts wins over deno.json).

Title: release.ts → assets + releases.json
Description: Implement scripts/release.ts: upload the built artifacts with a SHA-256 digest and prepend a release entry to both releases.json mirrors consumed by the website's /download route.
Acceptance Criteria: Running release publishes the assets and updates both releases.json files; the website's /download resolves to the new installer.
Notes: Does not build — uploads what build produced. S3 creds come from .env. Implemented 2026-09-21 plus dry-run green (setup.exe hashed sha256, both mirrors previewed, nothing written). Blocked: real publish needs S3 creds and the website phase for /download.

Title: Seed known-bugs.csv
Description: Populate plan/known-bugs.csv from the integration findings: the library's event-prefix split, the missing combobox dropdown ARIA, the undeclared wc-datepicker dependency, the unstyled shadow mode, the readme's incorrect .e-* class contract, and the CEF/webview Windows issue — each with severity, evidence and a pointer to the upstream audit sheet.
Acceptance Criteria: Every open integration risk from plan §16 is represented with a reproducible description; the file parses as CSV with the documented columns.
Notes: Header format must match the other plan CSVs in this repo.

Title: Website scaffold
